title_ja: 最終指定親会社自己資本比率告示
title_en: Capital Adequacy Notification for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies
issuing_authority: Financial Services Agency of Japan (金融庁)
scope_note: Test scope limited to Chapter 2 for prototyping the pipeline and app. The notification applies to Ultimate Designated Parent Companies (最終指定親会社) of designated financial instruments business groups under the FIEA, not to banks.

related_feeds.note: Use for terminology grounding — this notification transposes the Basel Framework into Japanese domestic rules. Not yet built as a feed; treat as a manual reference (bis.org/basel_framework) until/unless digitized.
